## Pull request checklist

- [ ] Scope is focused and the description explains the change.
- [ ] Relevant tests or documentation checks were run.
- [ ] No secrets, generated noise, or unrelated changes are included.

Tip-cite: `<8-char-main-tip> PR#<number> — <short description>`; resolve it against `main`. A tip-cite is not a readiness signal: this template makes no `READY` claim, and no `READY` status is asserted or implied; blocked or untested work is not `READY`.
